results.title: Centre & Assam Capable Of Managing Floods, No Foreign Aid Required: CM Sarma
results.description: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma said the state and Central governments are capable of handling flood relief and do not require international assistance. As rescue operations wind down, the focus has shifted to rehabilitation, including house repairs, medical camps, compensation, education support and financial relief. Floods have affected nearly 11 lakh people across 2,101 villages.

results.title: Axed by CSK, Stephen Fleming Set To Replace Compatriot Brendon McCullum As England Test Coach: Report
results.description: Stephen Fleming is set to be named as the new head coach of the England Test team just days after he was removed from the role at Chennai Super Kings (CSK) after a 17-year tenure. The former New Zealand captain will replace compatriot Bredon McCullum.
